scope: Source-pixel review of the 73 newly elevated page groups from the frozen batch-5 baseline plus explicitly identified adjacent companion-page evidence. It distinguishes confirmed present-but-unlinked passages from uncertain geometry cues and unassessed crops.

reviewMethod.method: Rendered source PDF page/crop pixels were compared with baseline catalog bounds, numeric text geometry and observed reading order. Text is not retained. Generic endpoint or edge flags alone never promote a case to confirmed missing; the three manual additions are source-pixel-confirmed owner crop sequences missed by generic pair output.
